label: Diagram 9.1
caption: Diagram 9.1 | Enclosure for drainage or water supply pipes
description: This is a section drawing with the title "Diagram 9.1 Enclosure for drainage or water supply pipes" in a green banner at the bottom and the note "See para 9.4 and Table 9.1" at the top left. A vertical stack pipe, marked with a break symbol, runs from top to bottom through the structure. To its left is a grey band labelled "Casing"; to its right is a green band labelled "Compartment wall". A pale area around the pipe is labelled "Enclosure" in two places. Diagonal lines projecting from the stack are labelled "Branch pipe". Two horizontal green lines across the drawing are labelled "Compartment floor carried through to seal enclosure – provide fire-stopping between stack pipe and floor" and "Intermediate floor carried through to seal enclosure – provide fire-stopping between stack pipe and floor", the lower right one also tagged "Compartment floor". Dark green patches at the pipe penetrations are "Fire-stopping around pipe". A legend defines the four colours. To the right, a NOTES block lists numbered points 1 to 3 concerning the enclosure, casing and pipe openings.
